inspiration: Player colour is a material switch (materials/player_trans_norm_spec.xml sets a player-colour define with spec and normal maps): one base texture with a spec and normal map gives a tintable, shiny armour look we can rebuild with our own shader.

Gold armour is a variant layer, not a new model: base texture plus gold texture plus spec texture (variants/shields/sele_pelte_01_gold.xml; skins/skeletal/ptol/cuirass_gold_01.png). A gold look is a palette and spec change.
Loot shimmer uses small particle presets (particles/coin.xml and coin_high.xml): a low-count sprite burst for normal drops and a higher-count variant for big drops.
Dust, sand, snow, smoke and cloud are reusable particle presets (particles/), so one preset set covers weather and destruction.
Units keep one template per civilisation with variant layers (actors/units per civ folder): a faction recolour and gear swap is cheaper than new models.
Ambient audio is layered by weather, time of day and water (audio/ambient/weather, dayscape, water): a layered ambient bed per zone is a clear pattern.
Maps use real-world heightmaps (NASA public-domain topography and OSM-derived heightmaps): for our zones, a heightmap from an image we own can drive terrain shape.
